purpose: Human/external-access queue for UK TCC CPOs after autonomous discovery. Use this instead of repeating web investigations.
regulatoryNote: UK PCPR requires reference and availability data to be publicly available free of charge and machine-readable, without requiring agreement to terms for use. Some operators nevertheless expose access through account/request/onboarding flows; treat these as access-path facts, not as proof the flows satisfy the regulation.
ecoMovementConsolidationNote: IONITY, evyve, Source EV, ubitricity and bp pulse routes all involve Eco-Movement. A single Eco-Movement technical identity may simplify integration, but operator grants may be scoped; verify scope before assuming one token covers all networks.

items.name: EV Charger Points / Charge & Go
items.humanAction: Email support@evcps.uk with identity, organisation and intended use; operator promises data within 48h.
items.blocker: Operator requires an email request to support@evcps.uk with requester identity, organisation and intended use; operator says data is supplied within 48 hours.
items.next: manual data request only if needed after all autonomous sources are exhausted.

items.name: Believ

items.blocker: Official Believ Open Data portal requires account creation before API documentation and credential generation.
items.next: Once credentials are available, ingest Believ locations/EVSE/status/tariff data without repeating endpoint discovery.

items.name: GRIDSERVE
items.humanAction: Submit the official GRIDSERVE Open Data form with name, email, purpose of request, and acceptance of the API fair-use terms.
items.blocker: Every GRIDSERVE PCPR API request requires an ec-subscription-key. The key is emailed by GRIDSERVE support after registration; target turnaround is within 5 business days.
items.next: When the key arrives, add it to Data Lab GitHub Secrets and ingest https://api.gridserve.com/ocpi/v1/ locations/EVSE/status/tariffs without repeating discovery.

items.name: evyve
items.humanAction: Submit Evyve's official PCPR Open Data Request form (Google Form linked from evyve.co.uk locations pages).
items.blocker: Evyve does not publish an anonymous machine-readable PCPR endpoint. Its official site states open-data access is provided after request via Eco-Movement, with a stated 48-hour turnaround.
items.next: When data/API details arrive, persist them and ingest locations/status/pricing without repeating discovery.

items.name: ChargePoint CMS UK

items.blocker: ChargePoint explicitly routes PCPR open-data API access through an external partner/request workflow rather than publishing anonymous endpoints.
items.next: complete partner open-data request with Network=ChargePoint CMS.

items.name: bp pulse / Chargemaster

items.next: obtain bp pulse/Eco-Movement API key; treat BPC/BPP/BPT as one family.
